content: {"like": ["The series is interesting and beautiful, offering historical insight into past lifestyles and societal issues.", "The portrayal of characters such as Nurse Crane, Patsy, Sr Evangelina, Pam Ferris as Sr Evangelina, Chummy, and the realistic, heartfelt scenes involving Patsy and Delia.", "The depth and authenticity of characters like Sr Julienne and the emotional impact of her death at the end of season 5."], "dislike": ["The writers make some characters too saintly and perfect, which the reviewer finds boring.", "Characters like Sister Mary Cynthia, Jenny, Trixie, and Sr Monica Joan are portrayed as one-note or lacking personality.", "The prevalence of smoking in hospital and other settings is revolting and unrealistic for the time period."]}
